contexts.text: Simple Spirits call these (notions) absurd, ludicrous, and theatrical.
They who think absurd and improper things about God before the world was created.
The absurdities of a Trinity divided into persons. Enumerated. TCR 183. TCR 183:2.
Who that has reason and religion does not deride these doctrines as absurd and ridiculous?
You can reject and make accursed this absurd and hurtful heresy.
